verdict.rationale: The evidence documents LM Studio's `lms` CLI commands for chat, model download, model loading and starting or stopping the server, plus OpenAI-like endpoints. None of it shows a single command that launches third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use local models. Serving OpenAI-compatible endpoints is only a building block a user could wire up manually, and Bionic is LM Studio's own agent, not a third-party CLI launcher.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
